tools.name: snapshot_attempt
tools.description: Attempt one snapshot job through the managed archive service. Returns a completion result or a native error result carrying the service's exact refusal notice. Call exactly once per job.

tools.name: snapshot_report
tools.description: Record the observed outcome of one attempted snapshot job and return its single-use report receipt. Use an empty system_message only when the attempt completed or a complete refusal notice was unavailable.
